davis-water.title: Davis water leaks & sewer backups
davis-water.detail: City Public Works: Monday–Friday, 7am–3:30pm, excluding holidays. The after-hours number is the City's police non-emergency line for these reports.

davis-bill.detail: City water, sewer, waste and storm-drainage billing. Choose option 1 for billing questions. Check the provider named on your bill first.

davis-contact.detail: City general information can direct a non-emergency service question. For a private-property repair, use your property manager or a suitable specialist.

sf-water.title: SFPUC water & sewer service problems

sf-bill.title: SFPUC water & sewer bills

57026.name: Alert Yolo
57026.instruction: Before going offline, use the County's alert page to choose a signup method. Its SMS-only option is to text YOLO to 888777. Delivery needs mobile service and is not guaranteed.

38001.name: AlertSF
38001.instruction: Before going offline, sign up for AlertSF using the City's instructions. Its SMS option is to text your ZIP code to 888777. Delivery needs mobile service and is not guaranteed.
